name: smoke
text: A person stands casually smoking a cigarette in the right hand. Raise the right fingertips to the lips, pause for a puff, then lower the right hand to waist level and exhale. The left arm hangs relaxed. Perform one clear hand-to-mouth puff and lower the hand again while standing in place.

scene.description: Start at level ground facing +Z. A person stands casually smoking a cigarette in the right hand. Raise the right fingertips to the lips, pause for a puff, then lower the right hand to waist level and exhale. The left arm hangs relaxed. Perform one clear hand-to-mouth puff and lower the hand again while standing in place. Hold held_cigarette with right at its grip marker. The left hand stays relaxed by the left thigh unless the description explicitly gives it a supporting task. Keep the held object outside the torso and legs, and keep fingers and forearms on the intended grasp side.

review.reason: The old assistant visual verdict lacks current per-activity final-runtime review evidence. Image existence and the generic batch note do not establish movement quality. This withdrawal does not assert that the motion is faulty.

visual_review.method: Visual review only. Initial whole-duration chronological overview at 5 fps, followed by full 30 fps sequences and close-ups where needed. No numerical quality gates or tests. Real-time viewing unavailable; do not claim live playback.
visual_review.observation: 0-3 s. Hand moves slightly around mouth but remains raised; inspect cigarette orientation and face contact. Whole 3 s front and side overview plus enlarged side frame: cigarette points outward from lower front of face; restrained inhale hold. This is a smoking hold, not an acquire-and-lower sequence.
visual_review.scope: The old assistant approval was withdrawn after missed activity and contact failures. Retained observations describe their historical scope and do not approve the current version.
